This removes only the redundant lower-bound clamp. With normalized inputs, all static terms are nonnegative, while the reliability correction is bounded below by `-0.04 * min(a, e)`. The motion terms alone contribute at least `0.55 * min(a, e)`, so the complete unbounded score cannot be negative. The upper clamp remains necessary because the correction can raise the maximum above 1.

The numerical score—and therefore false-clear, false-block, F1, ranking, stability, and negative-control behavior—should remain exactly unchanged. The improvement targets the complexity and runtime components of `COMBINED_SCORE`, reducing AST nodes and one nested function call without taking any safety tradeoff.
